The following events took place in '''26,000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] discovered the [[M'dweshuu]] [[Nova/Legends|nova]] and formed the [[Cult of M'dweshuu]], which gained control of the entire planet [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="TEGAS" />
*[[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] was colonized by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the colony [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Kuat Explorer]]''.
*[[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]] colonization arks had settled [[Axum]], [[Tepasi/Legends|Tepasi]] and [[Humbarine/Legends|Humbarine]].
*The [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] colonized the [[Roche asteroid field]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="TEGAS" />
